terms.label: Service date
terms.definition: Operator-local date for a run and its legs, paired with an explicit IANA timezone.
terms.distinction: Never inferred only from UTC or browser timezone.

terms.label: Trip request
terms.definition: One request grouping one or more passenger legs for a service episode.
terms.distinction: Not a vehicle run or necessarily one billable unit.

terms.label: Leg
terms.definition: Smallest independently executable passenger movement from one origin to one destination.
terms.distinction: Owns timing mode, outcome, execution, and billing evaluation.

terms.label: Stop task
terms.definition: Ordered pickup, drop-off, depot, break, wait, or operational task on a run.
terms.distinction: Not every stop task is a passenger leg.

terms.label: Run
terms.definition: Versioned ordered vehicle duty and manifest for a service date and operating window.

terms.label: Assignment
terms.definition: Versioned binding of a leg execution segment to a run and effective resources.

terms.label: Execution segment
terms.definition: Portion of a leg performed under one resource binding.
terms.distinction: Represents rescue or transfer without erasing prior execution.

terms.label: Standing order
terms.definition: Recurrence template that materializes dated trip requests.
terms.distinction: Template edits do not rewrite materialized instances.

terms.label: Will-call
terms.definition: Timing commitment whose pickup response clock starts after a durable readiness signal.

terms.label: Multi-load
terms.definition: Overlapping onboard intervals for multiple passenger legs in one vehicle.
terms.distinction: Capacity and ride-time constraints apply across the interval.

terms.label: Companion or escort
terms.definition: Non-rider occupant attached to a leg who consumes declared capacity.
terms.distinction: Not automatically a separate billable passenger leg.

terms.label: Authorization
terms.definition: Payer or broker approval of eligibility, mode, service, limits, or effective dates.

terms.label: Evidence
terms.definition: Append-only observed fact with source, capture time, provenance, and amendment lineage.
terms.distinction: Cannot directly mutate operational or financial state.

terms.label: Deadhead
terms.definition: Vehicle movement outside passenger-loaded or revenue service under the applicable reporting rule.
terms.distinction: Separate from loaded mileage and passenger-trip counts.

terms.label: Billing case
terms.definition: Policy evaluation for readiness, holds, charges, claim or invoice eligibility, and correction.
terms.distinction: Leg completion never automatically means billing-ready.

terms.label: Incident or exception case
terms.definition: Auditable operational condition requiring attention, resolution, or recovery.
terms.distinction: Does not erase underlying leg or run history.
